name: Favor for Krazek
summary: While repairing a crock pot brought down to Booty Bay, the goblin Krazek demands a personal favor in return. He wants rare lesser bloodstone ore retrieved from a distant cave in the northern hills before he will hand back the repaired cookware.

sections.title: A Northern Bargain
sections.body: After accepting the broken cookware in Booty Bay, Krazek pauses his tinkering to ask for a trade. Rather than repairing the pot for free, he directs you far northward into the Arathi Highlands. Within a cave in Drywhisker Gorge lies lesser bloodstone ore, a low-grade yet prized mineral sought after by those who understand its properties.

sections.title: Ore from the Gorge
sections.body: Krazek promises to work on fixing the pot while you make the long journey north. He expects four loads of the bloodstone brought back to the port, offering payment in exchange for the favor if you return with enough samples. He also makes it clear that if you lack the knowledge to extract the ore yourself, you will need to rely on someone who does.

faq.q: Who is Krazek and what does he want?
faq.answer: Krazek is a goblin operating in Booty Bay. While repairing a broken crock pot delivered to him, he asks for four loads of rare bloodstone ore to be hauled back from the north.

faq.q: Where is the bloodstone ore located?
faq.answer: The lesser bloodstone ore is found inside a mountain cave located in Drywhisker Gorge, situated far to the north within the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Why does Krazek want low-grade ore?
faq.answer: Although the deposits in the cave are not of the highest quality, Krazek notes that even low-grade bloodstone holds substantial value to anyone possessing the craft and knowledge to utilize it.
Before Krazek makes this demand, you are sent to Booty Bay to deliver the damaged vessel in Krazek's Cookery.

faq.q: What happens after gathering the bloodstone?
faq.answer: Once Krazek receives the four loads of ore and provides your compensation, the journey continues with Return to Corporal Kaleb.

angles.text: Krazek directly points out that harvesting the ore requires mining expertise, warning that anyone lacking the skill will need to find someone capable of extracting the veins.
